rationale: Three sensors in different rooms dropped within 2 seconds (21:44:00–21:44:02) while the base station stayed online with a good uplink and other devices (including farther cameras) remained connected. RSSI history for the affected sensors was normal (-55 to -66 dBm) and batteries were healthy, ruling out weak signal. The log shows E-610 radio module self-test warning, which the KB maps to a sub-GHz radio module failure requiring FAE escalation (matching historical case H-05).

output.symptom_summary: Three sensors (Back Door, Living Motion, Bedroom Window) went offline simultaneously within 2 seconds on the evening of the incident. complaint: Three sensors stopped responding within seconds of each other yesterday evening. I restarted the base station, hoping it would help, but they all stayed offline. The base station is at the far end of the flat from some of them, so maybe the signal is the problem. The front camera, which is farther away, is still online though.
